summary: Frontend-only verification of Android nav overlap fix (safe-area + Navbar refactor). Tested 5 viewports (Small 360x780, Medium 393x852, Large 412x915, Tablet 800x1280, Landscape 915x412). All required CSS vars are set, Navbar uses triple-redundant CSS max() with all 3 layers, all 5 nav tabs are visible and tappable with min-height >=48px, and navigation works to Discover/Likes/Alerts/Chats/Profile. However, the gap between action buttons and the navbar has REGRESSED versus iteration_22: it is now <24px on 4 of 5 viewports because the 8px CSS floor added to Navbar paddingBottom is not reflected in --nav-total.

ui_bugs.issue: Gap between action buttons and bottom navbar is <24px on Small (17px), Medium (18px), Large (20px), Landscape (15px). Only Tablet (31px) passes. This is a regression from iteration_22 where all portraits were >=24px.

action_items: HIGH: Fix action-buttons-to-navbar gap regression. Root cause: Navbar paddingBottom uses max(var(--safe-bottom,12px), env(...,0px), 8px) which yields 8px on web (safe-bottom=0), so actual navbar height = navInner + 8px. But --nav-total in safeArea.js is computed as navInner + safeBottom (i.e., navInner + 0 = navInner), so DiscoverPage's spacer (which uses --nav-total) reserves 8px too little. Two options: (a) In safeArea.js, floor safeBottom to at least 8 for non-native ('else' branch) OR compute navTotal = navInner + Math.max(safeBottom, 8); (b) Remove the 8px minimum from Navbar max() and rely purely on --safe-bottom. Recommend (a) with `const safePad = Math.max(safeBottom, 8); const navTotal = navInner + safePad;` so DiscoverPage layout accounts for actual navbar height.
MINOR (pre-existing): Console still emits React warning 'Received true for a non-boolean attribute jsx' (likely a <style jsx> attribute leaking to DOM in some component).

critical_code_review_comments: safeArea.js line 142: navTotal = navInner + safeBottom does not match actual navbar height because Navbar.jsx enforces a 8px floor via CSS max(). Consumers of --nav-total will under-reserve space by 8px whenever safeBottom<8. Compute navTotal against the same floor.

rca of the issue: Navbar.jsx paddingBottom='max(var(--safe-bottom,12px), env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px), 8px)' means on web (safe-bottom=0, env=0) the navbar has an EXTRA 8px paddingBottom, making actual nav height = navInner + 8px. But safeArea.js computes --nav-total = navInner + safeBottom = navInner + 0. DiscoverPage uses --nav-total to reserve space at the bottom of the discover-card-area, so it reserves 8px less than the nav's real footprint, eating into the action-button-to-navbar gap. On tablet the very large --card-pad (40px) absorbs the shortfall, but on small/medium/large/landscape the gap drops to 15-20px (below the 24px minimum). Fix in safeArea.js: use `const safePad = Math.max(safeBottom, 8); const navTotal = navInner + safePad;` and set --safe-bottom to safePad as well so the CSS max() in Navbar collapses to the same value.
